title: B1.11 Hupsel executable application-composition observation

frozen_interval_selection.selection_rule: first accepted soil-water interval start >= 12:00 local model time

observation_payload: active SWETR/SWDIVIDE/SWMETDETAIL/SWRAIN/SWINTER/SWCF selectors and crop identity/emergence state
gross rain, legacy interception, net rain and final dynamic-top precipitation/top-flux contribution with units/sign convention
daily/final potential soil evaporation, pond evaporation and potential transpiration
rooted-node count, cumulative root distribution and final nodewise root_extraction_sink(:)
drainage selectors/configuration, dynamic hydraulic inputs and resulting typed-equivalent control/transfer values
bottom-boundary selector and resulting bottom flux
irrigation/SSDI activation and any external-water contribution

comparison_rules.restricted_fapp04: Compare F-APP04 identity mappings only when the observed exact legacy route is inside SWETR=0, SWDIVIDE=1, SWMETDETAIL=0, SWRAIN=0, SWINTER=1, SWCF=1. Outside that selector set, record UNCOVERED_ROUTE and do not invoke/fallback the restricted adapter.
comparison_rules.current_reference_only: All executable observations are from reconstructed B1.11; B1.10 snapshots remain historical and are not relabelled.
comparison_rules.observation_only: Instrumentation may write diagnostics only and must not change state, forcing, equations, solver decisions, timestep/retry policy, tolerances or output semantics.
comparison_rules.noninterference: Normalized result.bal/result.blc identities must remain equal to the same uninstrumented B1.11 run before observation evidence is accepted.
comparison_rules.numeric_tolerance: Use exact identity for selector/integer/route fields; use 1e-12 absolute tolerance for transported cm/day process-ready scalar values unless an existing stricter immutable contract applies. Do not tune tolerance after observation.

pass_conditions: B1.11 reconstruction identity closes before execution.
The exact official Hupsel case runs successfully under the already qualified GNU portability procedure without scientific source change.
All six frozen interval selections are captured deterministically.
Every selected interval is classified before candidate comparison by exact active legacy route.
For every selected interval inside F-APP04 scope, PMdirect ptra, soil/pond evaporation demand and net-rain transport agree with admitted typed bindings at the preregistered tolerance.
Drainage and irrigation/SSDI observations are sufficient to classify the next remaining M1-C3 application-composition surface.
Instrumentation preserves normalized legacy output identities.
fail_closed_conditions: Any official Hupsel input identity mismatch.
A frozen interval cannot be selected unambiguously.
An unsupported SWINTER=3 or SWCF=2 route would need to be inferred or approximated to compare F-APP04.
Instrumentation changes accepted intervals, solver/retry behaviour or normalized legacy outputs.
Drainage or irrigation semantics cannot be observed without changing production/reference physics.
explicit_nonclaims: This campaign does not by itself implement SWINTER=3/Rutter or SWCF=2.
This campaign does not close whole-Hupsel equivalence or M1-C3 unless every active legacy application route is already admitted or separately qualified.
No output fitting or reverse engineering from result files is permitted.
next_if_pass: Persist the B1.11 observation artifact and narrow the next M1-C3 workunit to only the actually active uncovered application routes.
